title: Work Journal: a spell-check icon fixes spelling, grammar and punctuation of the selection or the whole page
story: The Work Journal toolbar gained a spell-check icon left of '+ Add entry', also Ctrl+Shift+F. It asks your own Claude CLI to fix spelling, grammar and punctuation of the selection (widened to whole words) or the whole day page; one Ctrl+Z undoes it and a short line reports the result. Times, links, project chips, the card's bold split and code blocks are never changed; a line whose fix would touch them, or a reply that rewrites text, is left exactly as it was. Nothing earlier was removed.

checks.criterion: With nothing selected, the whole page is fixed
checks.steps: Open today's Work Journal page. Type the free note 'I fixd teh login'. Add an entry and type 'Release wiht notes'. Click empty space, then the spell-check icon.
checks.expected: The icon spins and the page is locked; then the note reads 'I fixed the login', the card 'Release with notes', and '3 fixes made' shows and fades.

checks.criterion: With a selection, only the selection changes
checks.steps: Type 'teh start', then on a new line 'I fixd teh bug'. Select only 'I fixd' and press Ctrl+Shift+F.
checks.expected: Only 'I fixd' becomes 'I fixed'; both 'teh' stay; '1 fix made' shows.

checks.criterion: A selection ending inside a word fixes the whole word
checks.steps: Type 'I fixd the bug'. Select from the start up to 'th'. Press Ctrl+Shift+F.
checks.expected: The line reads 'I fixed the bug', never 'I fixed thee bug'.

checks.criterion: Times, links, project chips and the bold split are unchanged
checks.steps: Add a card at 10:30 with any project, text 'Fixd login: deploy at 10:30 wiht care', and a free note with a link to example.com. Click the spell-check icon.
checks.expected: Time, chip, link and bold split are unchanged; a line whose fix would touch them keeps its old text, while other lines are fixed.

checks.criterion: Code blocks are never sent or changed
checks.steps: Add a code block holding 'npm run biuld' and below it 'I fixd it'. Click the spell-check icon.
checks.expected: The code block still reads 'npm run biuld'; the line reads 'I fixed it'; '1 fix made'.

checks.steps: After any fix that made changes, press Ctrl+Z once.
checks.expected: The page is exactly as before the fix.

checks.criterion: A failure leaves the page unchanged and shows the reason
checks.steps: Take the Claude CLI off PATH or go offline, then click the spell-check icon.
checks.expected: The page is unchanged and a red line 'Not fixed: …' with the reason shows, then fades.
